'''Twilight''' is a pack leader of [[wolf|wolves]].

==Activities==
Twilight, along with [[Three Toes]], [[Cold Water]] and [[Springhorn]], are wolves known to [[Perrin Aybara]]. He contacts them to ask for their help in searching for his wife, [[Faile Bashere]]. They cannot help.{{ref/book|9|2}}
